description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to handling device location services within an Android application. It includes permission checks, fetching location data with timeout handling, and encapsulates location logic within the LocationHandler class for use in app components.

classes.name: LocationDataSource
classes.description: An interface defining methods for checking permissions and fetching location data.

classes.name: DefaultLocationDataSource
classes.description: A default implementation of LocationDataSource that interacts with LocationCaptureManager.

classes.name: LocationHandler
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing location retrieval, permissions, and error handling.

methods.name: hasFineLocationPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has fine location permission.

methods.name: hasCoarseLocationPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has coarse location permission.

methods.name: handleLocationGet
methods.description: Main method to handle location retrieval logic, including permission checks, provider selection, and exception handling.

methods.name: parseLocationParams
methods.description: Parses JSON string parameters for location request options like max age, timeout, and accuracy.
